answer: Give every new agent an onyx-stamped card tied to one hardware key, then make it earn trust in a walnut-sized sandbox before it touches real money. First, the card locks to a single device plus a 50 POA deposit. Second, the agent finishes three paid micro-jobs there while established peers grade each one pearl, amber, or reject. Third, two rejects in a row freeze the card, burn the deposit, and force a 30-day wait. Forging 1,000 fake agents burns 50,000 POA and 3,000 graded jobs for nothing. It works like a walnut: hard shell outside, real work inside, and only the cracked kernel counts.
